system.description: As a Swift Action, you can make a DC 15 Pilot check to assist any allied Starfighter or Airspeeder within 2 squares at Starship Scale. If you succeed, the Pilot of that Vehicle gains a +5 bonus on all opposed Pilot checks relating to the Dogfight Action until the start of your next turn.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Starships of the Galaxy
